overview:
**Moderate fire danger holds today, driven by dry fuels and low humidity rather than wind or heat.**
- Fire indices climb gradually through the week — ERC rises from 55% to 66% and BI from 56% to 62% by Oct 10, though the adjective rating stays Moderate the whole period.
- Sunny, calm weather dominates: light NNE winds near 5-8 mph, afternoon highs sliding from the mid-60s into the mid-50s, and no measurable rain expected except a trace Tuesday.
- None of the 7 local watchout thresholds are currently met, and no Red Flag Warning or other NWS alerts are active for the area.
- Stage 1 Fire Restrictions are in effect in unincorporated Montrose County effective September 4, 2026, with similar Stage 1 restrictions remaining in Delta County due to ongoing drought and high fire danger and in unincorporated Ouray County.
- Gunnison Field Office BLM lands lifted Stage 1 restrictions on September 18, 2026; only standard year-round wildfire prevention rules remain in effect.
- No active wildfires are currently burning in or near this area's counties.
